salvageable_components.item_name: flush steel door leaf with fire-rated core

technical_features.labels_or_markings: No visible manufacturer labels or certification badges; small black circular device near top right corner may be a fire alarm or smoke detector sensor.

salvageable_components.deconstruction_notes: Remove hinges first, then carefully detach door from frame. Inspect core for moisture or degradation. Core may contain asbestos if pre-1980s; test if uncertain. Clean surface and repaint for reuse.

Lift out manually; no disassembly required. Clean with wire brush and mild detergent. Suitable for reuse in storage or utility areas.

hazard_and_diagnostic_flags: Core material of steel doors may contain legacy asbestos insulation; verify via sampling if building predates 1980.
Black baseboard trim may contain lead-based paint; test if building predates 1978.
Mastic or sealant at door frame joints may contain VOCs or hazardous adhesives; inspect and test if necessary.
